name: Premium Serif
tagline: Neelshah's Premium preset: near-black, bone and antique gold, a thin high-contrast serif at 80 BPM, nothing rushed.

motion.direction: Neelshah `Premium`. 80 BPM: enter 1.10 s / stagger 0.12 / exit 0.60. Playfair 400 display at 160 px in sentence case, caps labels tracked 0.24 em, radius 2, antique gold `ter` the only colour on bone `iv`. Holds ≥ 2 s after a line lands; cuts every 2–4 bars; secondary motion a 1–3 % push; anticipation 2–6 %. Captions are clean full sentences, small, lower third. A `counter` rolls slowly; `imageCard`s are straight and large; a `chapterCard` as a quiet title plate. No slams, no stamps, no shakes, ≤ 1 flash per reel.
